ca449c6b1f5231.s: Which body nominated Khaled El-Enany for the post of UNESCO Director-General on 6 October 2025?
ca449c6b1f5231.x: The UNESCO Executive Board nominated him at its 222nd session; the final appointment was left to the General Conference in Uzbekistan.

ca308f19ee007d.s: Khaled El-Enany of Egypt, nominated in 2025, would become UNESCO's first:
ca308f19ee007d.x: El-Enany, an Egyptologist and Egypt's former Minister of Antiquities, would be the first Arab Director-General of UNESCO.

ca912e69425028.s: Who is the Chairman of the Indian Red Cross Society?
ca912e69425028.x: The Union Health Minister is the Chairman of the IRCS, while the President of India is its President.

n23f87b8b23a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the selection of the next UN Secretary-General?
o: Antonio Guterres leaves office at the end of 2026
The successor's term will be six years
The successor's term begins on 1 January 2027
The UNGA appoints the Secretary-General on the UNSC's recommendation (Article 97)
n23f87b8b23a.x: The successor's term starting 1 January 2027 is five years, not six; the other statements are correct.

na3ca6775f85.s: In the July 2026 women's Test at Lord's, Yastika Bhatia earned a place on the honours board by scoring:
na3ca6775f85.x: Yastika Bhatia scored 113, and Kranti Gaud took a five-wicket haul; they were the first women on the Lord's honours board.

nc91db8c2b03.s: T.K. Oommen, who died in February 2026, was a noted:
nc91db8c2b03.x: T.K. Oommen was a sociologist (Padma Bhushan 2008); 'journalist and author' describes Mark Tully.

new.s: Sanae Takaichi, who took office on 21 October 2025, became the first woman Prime Minister of:
new.x: Sanae Takaichi (LDP) became Japan's first woman and 104th Prime Minister, succeeding Shigeru Ishiba.

new.s: Friedrich Merz was elected Chancellor of Germany on 6 May 2025:
o: In the first round, with 310 votes
In the second round the next day, with 316 votes
In the second round the same day, with 325 votes
In the first round, with 325 votes
new.x: Merz failed in the first round (310 votes, 6 short) and won the second round the same day with 325 of 630 votes.

new.s: Pope Leo XIV (Robert Francis Prevost), elected on 8 May 2025, is the first pope from:
new.x: Pope Leo XIV, an Augustinian who served long in Peru, is the first American pope; he succeeded Pope Francis.

new.s: Kirsty Coventry of Zimbabwe took office on 23 June 2025 as the ____ President of the IOC.
new.x: Coventry became the 10th IOC President, the first woman and first African to hold the post, for an 8-year term.

new.s: For how many years is Khaled El-Enany's term as UNESCO Director-General, beginning 15 November 2025?
new.x: El-Enany took office on 15 November 2025 for a 4-year term, succeeding Audrey Azoulay.

new.s: Who became the first Buddhist Chief Justice of India in May 2025?
new.x: B.R. Gavai, the 52nd CJI, was the first Buddhist and second Dalit CJI; he succeeded Sanjiv Khanna.

new.s: Under Article 67(a), Jagdeep Dhankhar addressed his resignation as Vice President in July 2025 to the:
new.x: A Vice President resigns by writing to the President under Article 67(a), not to the Speaker or the Chairman.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2025 Vice-Presidential election:
1. C.P. Radhakrishnan won with 452 first-preference votes.
2. Members of State Legislative Assemblies were part of the electoral college.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Radhakrishnan (NDA) won with 452 votes against 300 to become the 15th VP; the electoral college has members of both Houses of Parliament only.

new.s: Wing Commander Vyomika Singh, who co-led the Operation Sindoor press briefing on 7 May 2025, belongs to the:
new.x: Wg Cdr Vyomika Singh is an IAF helicopter pilot; Col. Sofiya Qureshi, the other briefing officer, is from the Army's Corps of Signals.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of woman and 'first' is correctly matched?
o: Kirsty Coventry – First woman UNESCO Director-General
Satsuki Katayama – First woman Prime Minister of Japan
Sanae Takaichi – First woman Finance Minister of Japan
Sofiya Qureshi – Women officers' Operation Sindoor briefing
new.x: Col. Sofiya Qureshi and Wg Cdr Vyomika Singh were the first two women officers to lead the Operation Sindoor briefing; Takaichi is the first woman PM and Katayama the first woman Finance Minister of Japan.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla?
o: He was the pilot of Axiom-4
He was the first Indian in space
He was the first Indian on the ISS
His Dragon capsule 'Grace' docked on 26 June 2025
new.x: Shukla was the first Indian on the ISS but the second Indian in space; Rakesh Sharma (1984) was the first.

new.s: How many climbers did the Indian Army Adventure Wing put on Everest on 27 May 2025, a single-day record for one expedition?
new.x: The Silver Jubilee expedition put 49 on the summit (22 Army personnel and 27 Sherpas) in one day, a Guinness record.

new.s: Carlo Acutis, the first millennial saint, was canonised on 7 September 2025 by:
new.x: Acutis's canonisation was the first of Pope Leo XIV's papacy, not of Pope Francis.

new.s: Pier Giorgio Frassati, canonised along with Carlo Acutis in 2025, died in 1925 of:
new.x: Frassati, an Italian, died of polio in 1925 at the age of 24.

new.s: Who was the only person of Indian origin on the TIME 100 list of April 2025?
new.x: TIME 100 (2025) had no Indian national; Reshma Kewalramani, CEO of Vertex Pharmaceuticals, was the only person of Indian origin.

new.s: Which publication brings out the 'World's Billionaires' list that ranked Mukesh Ambani 18th in April 2025?
new.x: The World's Billionaires list is published by Forbes; TIME publishes the TIME 100.

new.s: Jane Goodall, a UN Messenger of Peace from 2002 who died in 2025, was a noted:
new.x: Jane Goodall was a British primatologist and chimpanzee expert known for her work at Gombe Stream.

new.s: Which UN Secretary-General appointed Jane Goodall a UN Messenger of Peace in 2002?
new.x: Jane Goodall was appointed UN Messenger of Peace in 2002 by Kofi Annan.

new.s: V. Srinivas, Secretary of DARPG, was elected President (2025–2028) of which body headquartered in Brussels?
new.x: V. Srinivas was elected President of the IIAS (Brussels) on 3 June 2025 with 87 of 141 votes.

new.s: In August 2025, at its General Conference in Phuket, India became Chair of the Executive Board of the:
new.x: India became Chair of the AIBD Executive Board at the 23rd General Conference in Phuket, Thailand.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of person who died in 2025 and field is correctly matched?
o: K. Kasturirangan – Hoyle-Narlikar theory of gravity
new.x: Zubeen Garg was an Assamese singer; Kasturirangan was ISRO Chairman and led the NEP 2020 committee, while Narlikar was the Hoyle-Narlikar astrophysicist.

new.s: Jayant Narlikar, who died in May 2025, was the founder-director of:
new.x: Astrophysicist Jayant Narlikar founded and directed IUCAA, Pune; ISRO links to Kasturirangan.

new.s: Shibu Soren, who died in August 2025, was the founder of the:
new.x: Shibu Soren, a tribal leader and former Jharkhand CM, founded the JMM.

new.s: Chadalawada Naga Rani, given the AP State Red Cross Award, was then Collector of which district?
new.x: Naga Rani, Collector of West Godavari, won the award for 2023–24 and 2024–25 for Budameru flood relief.

new.s: How many members are on the Managing Body of the Indian Red Cross Society?
new.x: The IRCS Managing Body has 18 members: 6 plus the Chairman nominated by the President, and 12 elected by branches.

new.s: Tarique Rahman, sworn in as Prime Minister of Bangladesh on 17 February 2026, is the chairman of which party?
new.x: Tarique Rahman heads the BNP, which won 209 of 297 seats; the Awami League was excluded from the vote.

new.s: In the 12 February 2026 Bangladesh election, how many of the 297 seats did the BNP win?
new.x: The BNP won 209 of 297 seats and Jamaat-e-Islami 68; Tarique Rahman then became PM.

new.s: Who is the 9th Chairperson of the National Commission for Women, in office since October 2024?
new.x: Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar became the 9th NCW chairperson, succeeding Rekha Sharma.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of person and post (as of September 2026) is correctly matched?
o: Krishna Swaminathan – 31st Chief of the Naval Staff
Surya Kant – 52nd Chief Justice of India
Dhiraj Seth – 31st Chief of the Army Staff
new.x: Dhiraj Seth is the 31st COAS; Swaminathan is the 27th CNS, Surya Kant the 53rd CJI and Rahatkar the 9th NCW chairperson.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about nominated members of the Rajya Sabha:
1. The President nominates up to 12 members under Article 80.
2. Members are nominated by the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
3. Ujjwal Nikam and Meenakshi Jain were nominated in July 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The President (not the Chairman) nominates up to 12 members under Article 80; Ujjwal Nikam and Meenakshi Jain were among the July 2025 nominees.

new.s: UN Messengers of Peace are chosen by the:
new.x: UN Messengers of Peace are chosen by the UN Secretary-General.

new.s: Who is the youngest-ever UN Messenger of Peace, designated in 2017?
new.x: Malala Yousafzai, designated in 2017, is the youngest-ever UN Messenger of Peace.

new.s: Kranti Gaud entered the Lord's honours board in the July 2026 women's Test for:
new.x: Kranti Gaud took a five-wicket haul; Yastika Bhatia's 113 put her on the board too.

new.s: Whom did TIME name its Person of the Year for 2025 (announced 11 December 2025)?
new.x: TIME's 2025 Person of the Year was a group, 'The Architects of AI'; 'The American Soldier' was the 2003 choice.

new.s: According to the Forbes World's Billionaires list 2026, how many billionaires does India have?
new.x: Forbes 2026 lists 229 Indian billionaires, 3rd after the USA (989) and China; 3,428 is the global total.

new.s: Jürgen Habermas, who died in March 2026, was a German:
new.x: Habermas was a German philosopher; Sumit Sarkar and K.N. Panikkar were historians and T.K. Oommen a sociologist.

new.s: Mudragada Padmanabham, whose family declined state honours at his death in July 2026, led which movement in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Mudragada Padmanabham was the leader of the Kapu movement in AP.
